rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that people live or reside in a place.

example.english: We inhabit that house by the sea.
example.traditional: 我哋一家人住喺海邊嗰間屋。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 zyu6 hai2 hoi2 bin1 go2 gaan1 uk1

rows.note: Use this natural Cantonese construction when something is present inside a mind or other space, rather than saying it is lived in.

example.english: Lots of new ideas inhabit my mind.
example.traditional: 我個腦入面有好多新諗法。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 nou5 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 san1 nam2 faat3
